mapper.select: SELECT P.PACKAGE_ID AS packageId, P.PACKAGE_NAME AS packageName, P.PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION AS packageDescription, P.PACKAGE_GRADE AS packageGrade, P.PACKAGE_PRICE AS packagePrice, P.PACKAGE_STATUS AS packageStatus, P.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, P.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, ( SELECT PI.IMAGE_URL FROM PACKAGE_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PACKAGE_ID = P.PACKAGE_ID AND PI.IMAGE_TYPE = 'THUMBNAIL' ) AS thumbnailUrl FROM PACKAGE P WHERE P.PACKAGE_GRADE = #{packageGrade} AND P.PACKAGE_STATUS = 'SELLING' ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PACKAGE WHERE PACKAGE_GRADE = #{packageGrade} AND PACKAGE_STATUS = 'SELLING'

SELECT P.PACKAGE_ID AS packageId, P.PACKAGE_NAME AS packageName, P.PACKAGE_DESCRIPTION AS packageDescription, P.PACKAGE_GRADE AS packageGrade, P.PACKAGE_PRICE AS packagePrice, P.PACKAGE_STATUS AS packageStatus, P.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, P.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt, ( SELECT PI.IMAGE_URL FROM PACKAGE_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PACKAGE_ID = P.PACKAGE_ID AND PI.IMAGE_TYPE = 'THUMBNAIL' ) AS thumbnailUrl FROM PACKAGE P WHERE P.PACKAGE_ID = #{packageId}

SELECT PI.PACKAGE_ITEM_ID AS packageItemId, PI.PACKAGE_ID AS packageId, PI.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, PI.ITEM_ROLE AS itemRole, PI.ITEM_ORDER AS itemOrder, PI.QUANTITY AS quantity, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRICE AS productPrice, ( SELECT IMAGE_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER ASC, IMAGE_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbnailUrl FROM PACKAGE_ITEM PI JOIN PRODUCT P ON PI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE PI.PACKAGE_ID = #{packageId} ORDER BY PI.ITEM_ORDER ASC

SELECT PIO.PACKAGE_ITEM_OPTION_ID AS packageItemOptionId, PIO.PACKAGE_ITEM_ID AS packageItemId, PIO.OPTION_PRODUCT_ID AS optionProductId, PIO.ADDITIONAL_PRICE AS additionalPrice, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRICE AS productPrice, ( SELECT IMAGE_URL FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER ASC, IMAGE_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbnailUrl FROM PACKAGE_ITEM_OPTION PIO JOIN PACKAGE_ITEM PI ON PIO.PACKAGE_ITEM_ID = PI.PACKAGE_ITEM_ID JOIN PRODUCT P ON PIO.OPTION_PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE PI.PACKAGE_ID = #{packageId} ORDER BY PI.ITEM_ORDER ASC, PIO.PACKAGE_ITEM_OPTION_ID ASC

SELECT PACKAGE_EXTRA_ID AS packageExtraId, PACKAGE_ID AS packageId, EXTRA_TYPE AS extraType, EXTRA_NAME AS extraName, IS_REQUIRED AS isRequired, DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder FROM PACKAGE_EXTRA WHERE PACKAGE_ID = #{packageId} ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER ASC

SELECT PEO.PACKAGE_EXTRA_OPTION_ID AS packageExtraOptionId, PEO.PACKAGE_EXTRA_ID AS packageExtraId, PEO.OPTION_NAME AS optionName, PEO.ADDITIONAL_PRICE AS additionalPrice, PEO.DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder FROM PACKAGE_EXTRA_OPTION PEO JOIN PACKAGE_EXTRA PE ON PEO.PACKAGE_EXTRA_ID = PE.PACKAGE_EXTRA_ID WHERE PE.PACKAGE_ID = #{packageId} ORDER BY PE.DISPLAY_ORDER ASC, PEO.DISPLAY_ORDER ASC
